text: {"headline":"Press 4 Interlock, Inspection and Follow-Up Records Review","overview":"This brief summarizes documented records relating to Press 4 interlock status, the 4 March 2026 safety inspection sign-off, and subsequent documented actions, distinguishing documented entries from reporter allegations and noting unresolved dates and verification limits.","key_points":["Documented record states Iven Pell isolated Press 4 after the interlock failed. [C001, C002]","Documented record states on 4 March 2026 PERSON_1 PERSON_1 signed the Press 4 safety inspection as complete, with the checklist reporting a 0.18-second stop on all four cycles. [C003, C008]","Documented record states the handheld meter was in calibration stores that morning according to the issue register, and a green sticker alone does not establish that a functional test happened. [C009, C010]","Documented record states PERSON_1 PERSON_1 instructed maintenance to copy February's guard-test readings into the March sheet two days later. [C004]","Documented record shows the production schedule indicates a customer rush order but does not authorize skipping the test. [C012, C013]","Documented records state in early April PERSON_1 approved a replacement interlock for Press 4 and after the audit Iven Pell photographed the unsealed test terminal, while the audit date is not on the calendar extract and remains unconfirmed. [C005, C006, C014]","Reporter allegations, not independently verified in documents, state the guard failed to stop the press, the night team isolated it and told the day lead, and the reporter saved the checklist because the four identical readings looked wrong. [C015, C016, C017]","There is no injury report in this packet. [C011]"],"risk_notes":["If March readings were copied from February as the documented instruction states, the March test record would not reflect independent measurements.","Identical stop-time values combined with the meter location record create uncertainty about whether a functional test was performed as recorded.","Reliance on a green sticker without corroborating test documentation leaves verification incomplete."],"limitations":["Evidence does not establish that a functional test actually occurred on 4 March 2026; the meter location and the limitation of a green sticker are documented but do not prove or disprove testing.","Evidence does not establish as fact that Press 4 was restarted after isolation; the available passage only reports what a 2 March log says.","Evidence does not establish who physically entered readings; the reporter states they cannot identify the entrant and notes the restart entry was already in the shared file with a date that might be a copied template.","Evidence does not establish the audit date; it is absent from the calendar extract and remains unconfirmed.","Evidence does not provide independent document corroboration for reporter allegations about the guard failure and night-team actions, and absence of an injury report in the packet is not evidence that no injury occurred."]}
